rationale: The browser-based project analytics tool locates problem areas and trends, displays schedule/cost data, supports audits, and manages workflow and data quality.
evidence_spans: Empower is the first and only browser-based analytical tool that integrates earned value, schedule, work authorization, and other key performance data to enable proactive management of complex projects.
quickly locate problem areas, identify trends, display element-of-cost information, graphically display schedule Gantt information
